title: Only a Holy God
lyrics_original: Who else commands all the hosts of heaven?
Who else could make every king bow down?
Who else can whisper and darkness trembles?
What other beauty demands such praises?
What other splendour outshines the sun?
What other majesty rules with justice?
Come and worship the Holy God.
What other glory consumes like fire?
What other power can raise the dead?
Come and worship the Holy God.
Who else could rescue me from my failing?
Who else would offer His only Son?
Who else invites me to call Him Father?
Come and worship the Holy God
Come and worship the Holy God!

bible_verses.english: One called to another and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is Yahweh of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”
“You are worthy, our Lord and God, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power; for you created all things, and because of your desire they existed, and were created!”
Worship Yahweh in holy splendor. Tremble before him, all the earth.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord, You alone are holy, seated in unmatched splendor and supreme authority. Yet in Your profound mercy, You invite me into Your presence to behold Your goodness. Help me to fix my eyes on Your beauty today and rest in Your righteous reign over my life. Silence my fears with the truth of who You are—my magnificent, holy God. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When we pause to contemplate the majestic power and perfect beauty of our God, our hearts naturally bow in wonder. He is the sovereign Creator who commands the heavens, yet He gently invites us to draw near and behold His glory. In a world of fleeting shadows, His radiant holiness stands as an unchanging anchor of justice and grace. May this song remind you today that your life is held by the One who outshines every darkness.
